phase: BACKLOG bug batch -- three Builder fixes shipped together: (1) 'I should be able to duplicate scenes' -- the Scene Config panel gains a real '⧉ Duplicate This Scene' button (the old Scene Library grid's own Duplicate became unreachable dead code once the bottom Scenes strip replaced the grid); duplicateScene now lands the copy right after its source in the strip AND repairs Experience linkage instead of leaving frozen orphan mirrors -- a PUBLIC experience gains a real attachment on the copy (its mirrored layer adopted in place, so later edits reach the copy; usageOf reports both scenes), a PERSONAL experience's mirrored layer in the copy is flattened into a plain independent layer (tags stripped, visuals kept, no false linkage a one-scene-scoped Personal could never honour). (2) 'collapse, expand, duplicate experience elements' -- every part card header collapses/expands (chevron toggle, module-level Set keyed exp.id+'/'+part.id so the state survives every _renderContextPanel rebuild; a workspace preference, never World data); a '⧉' duplicate-part header button (fresh id, lands right after its source, never index 0 so the primary-part flat-field mirror can never change underneath, same 5-part cap as Add a Part, enforced at the model layer); every Gallery AND Nursery card gains '⧉ Duplicate' -- the clone is always born Nurturing with zero attachments and no scope (a template to grow from, never an auto-placed twin), landing right after its source. (3) 'during publishing check, it should show me all the assets unused but on supabse' -- the Publish modal gains a Publishing Check section: Check Remote Assets diffs what THIS Build actually uses (the compiled package's own assets keys, the exact relPaths publish() uploads) against what's genuinely stored under the Theme in the Personal Repository (new ThemeRepositoryClient.listAssetPaths, reusing the recursive _listAllObjectPaths), shows On-Supabase/Used/Unused stats + the orphan relPath list, and a confirm-gated Remove button (new ThemeRepositoryClient.deleteAssets) that re-runs the check afterward so the fresh Storage stats ARE the confirmation. Personal-only by design: Official is self-healing (every Promote clears its prefix wholesale first).
